title: mspp_website
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): mspp_createdby, mspp_DefaultLanguage, mspp_footerwebtemplateid, mspp_headerwebtemplateid, mspp_modifiedby, mspp_parentwebsiteid.

mspp_createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

mspp_modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was modified.

mspp_name.description: The name of the custom entity.

mspp_primarydomainname.description: Tracks the primary domain name of the Portal

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Website

_mspp_defaultlanguage_value.description: Lookup to Website Language - the current default language of the website

_mspp_footerwebtemplateid_value.description: Web Template to use as Website footer content.

_mspp_headerwebtemplateid_value.description: Web Template to use as Website header content.

_mspp_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_mspp_parentwebsiteid_value.description: Unique identifier for Website associated with Website.
